ctx.x: And you were with what band?

items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: Well, he would play with Chris Kelly's band and I would play with Celestine.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything about Red Happy's drumming? Anything about him? because I never got to hear him.

I tell you, he was a great drum player. Him and I used to fight all the time. It was a long time before they could find out who was the best, him or I. Well, quite naturally, they had friends of his and friends of mine. My friends would say I was the best. His friends would say he was the best. So I had come up. They had a telltale showdown at the Italian Hall. Espinade between Burgundy and Rampo. Well, he would play with Chris Kelly's band and I would play with Celestine. So it come down to a showdown. Well, so…
